name: quest-perf
description: Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3/3S platform performance for Unity apps: CPU/GPU/pacing triage, per-device budgets and quality tiers, frame pacing and thermals, resolution and foveation, Application SpaceWarp, compositor layers, mixed-reality costs, Meta SDK choices, and profiling tools (OVR Metrics Tool, MQDH, Perfetto, RenderDoc Meta Fork, ovrgpuprofiler).
